title: Offline Maps, DC Bus Shift Routing & Transit Accuracy
releaseNotes: Unblocked Jeepney and DC Bus maps when offline so computed routes, pins, and stops stay visible without waiting on map tiles.
Filtered DC Bus route suggestions strictly by active AM/PM operating shifts and ₱0.00 fare rules.
Improved walking path recovery, transfer polyline accuracy, and boarding/transfer wait time estimates across Davao routes.
